summary_en: Hokko Chemical raised FY2026 November period dividend forecast by 10 yen per share to 37 yen (full-year 64 yen). Company aims for 40% consolidated payout ratio by FY2029 under new long-term plan through FY2035, continuing progressive dividend policy with regular increases.
title_en: Notice on Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Hokko Chemical announced on October 27, 2026 that it had revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026. The final dividend per share was increased by 10 yen from the previously announced 27 yen to 37 yen. Combined with the interim dividend of 27 yen already paid, the full-year dividend per share for FY2026 is now projected at 64 yen, up 10 yen from the previous forecast of 54 yen.

The revision reflects the board's adoption of a new long-term management plan covering fiscal years 2027 through 2035, with a vision of growing the company into a one-trillion-yen revenue enterprise by fiscal 2050, marking the company's 100th anniversary. Within this framework, the first phase three-year plan (FY2027–2029) sets a consolidated dividend payout ratio target of 40% excluding extraordinary gains and losses by FY2029. The company will maintain its progressive dividend policy and pursue continuous dividend increases toward that target.

The dividend revision is subject to approval at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for February 2027.
